rationale: Seminumerical COSX changes the exchange approximation and carries an explicit quadrature/model-error identity. It is not an interchangeable execution provider for exact exchange and therefore must not be selected merely from a performance crossover.
revisit_condition: Keep COSX explicit in the mathematical Fock request. Automatic provider selection may choose only among implementations of the already selected COSX model, never between exact exchange and COSX.
